notes: The current route graph is assembled in Dart from manually mapped corridor segments and door anchors; this file documents the implementation and is not yet the graph data source.
Stair transitions are explicitly configured in RouteEngine._verticalStairs.
Hidden corridor segments remain routable; hidden controls map rendering only.
Any changes to floor plans, corridor segments, door anchors, or stair links should be checked with navigation route tests.
Door and place anchors farther than 450 source-map pixels from every corridor segment are left disconnected instead of being routed through potentially obstructing walls.
The second-floor campus branch has an explicit connector to the main turquoise corridor because its endpoints are 32 source-map pixels apart, beyond the 25 px node-snap tolerance.

navigationAssistant.operation: Offline natural-language requests can open a route from the bundled school map.
navigationAssistant.safety: The language model must not invent corridor links, doors, stairs, floor changes, or route geometry. RouteEngine validates graph connectivity and remains the deterministic path solver.
